gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored: topical houses now Lilly CA I.7 + Valens IX. Still classical only. Ptolemy I.13 is not a 12-house list.

Ptolemy Tetrabiblos I.13 gives four-angle temperament (east dry, south hot, west moist, north cold), not 12 topical houses. Lilly ascribes this house list to 'Ptolomeian Doctrine' (CA I.7 close). A source citing Ptolemy is not Ptolemy+Lilly consensus. Attribution unverified from the opened Tetrabiblos locus. Do not mark compared.
No ASC/MC Layer-1 identity objects: I.13 is directional temperament, not persona/status packages.
Layer 3 required slots filled only with Lilly's topical lists. Do not add modern 'psychological houses' (self-actualization, etc.).
Valens IX also gives derived-place meanings (this place relative to III/IV/VII). Schema has no derived-place slot; not copied into domain.
